scope: Static feasibility of shared reconstructed face-volume flux using actual C QR gradients and paired real faces at t2 circular diagnostic geometry. No time evolution, no production physics changed.
limitations: Far frozen cap edges are absent; this operator is not a complete boundary model.
Stored geometric volumes remain the normalization here; adopting independent volumes requires positivity and physical meaning.
Weight-based realization would need a compatible work/force model and proof against secular weight growth.
Affine and conservation checks do not establish shock or long-term Kepler stability.
decision: Static algebraic candidate passes active-region affine/rigid-motion and full paired-graph adjoint/constant-pressure tests. Not adopted into evolution. Must resolve geometric versus thermodynamic volume compatibility before any long-time claim.
attempt_history: Initial raw-face attempt failed reciprocity assertion; final uses actual C shf_common exported shared geometry. No averaging of unequal raw faces. One existing unpaired far-frozen face omitted and reported. Earlier v3 pressure-rate diagnostic used ideal 5/3 float; final reads actual params gamma.

definition.face_velocity: v_face = 0.5*(v_i + G_i*(c-x_i) + v_j + G_j*(c-x_j)); G from actual C QR linear map.
definition.volume_rate: Bv = signed incidence times face_area*(normal dot v_face).
definition.pressure_force: F = B^T P using the transpose of the full reconstruction, including neighbor contributions.
definition.internal_energy_rate: Udot_i = -P_i*(Bv)_i; this is a proposed compatible pair, not the implemented original geometric-volume equation.
definition.invariance_scope: Affine and rigid modes tested in r<2.5; net force/torque measured for pressure supported there to avoid periodic/cap boundary ambiguity.
definition.pressure_variance_scope: Instantaneous compression contribution only, current-radius membership; no TCF/HG or evolved trajectory.
